Archival Dispatch: 19 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Hoosier Hot Shots, The Story Lady, and Pepper Young's Family

Batch 25 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 25 resolves 19 historical master recordings: 8 wartime syndicated musical comedy transcriptions of The Hoosier Hot Shots (featuring their signature washboard, slide whistle, and novelty jazz hits like Rosie the Riveter and Sioux City Sue), 8 delightful 1947 fairytale broadcasts from The Story Lady (narrated by pioneering radio storyteller Georgene Faulkner), and 3 pre-war 1941 master episodes of Elaine Carrington's beloved daytime drama Pepper Young's Family.

1. The Hoosier Hot Shots — 1944–1945 Syndicated Transcription Discs Dated

Ken Trietsch, Paul 'Hezzie' Trietsch, Charles Ward, and Frank Kettering in top musical form:
